rule: These directives are the current operator authority. Registered research, remediation, promotion, integration, validation and deployment workflows may enforce but may not redefine them. The repository has one canonical runtime generation: V7.

paper_v7_authorization.interpretation: 100% is a hard ceiling, not a target. Kelly, sleeve cash, executable depth, authoritative fees, slippage, adverse markout, uncertainty/capital-time economics, state integrity and the 15% drawdown kill switch remain binding.

architecture.target: one unified V7 PAPER engine on main

model_contracts.pca: single-leg residual statistical arbitrage only; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; no mandatory hedge basket, terminal-probability semantics or binary Kelly
model_contracts.local_factor: leave-targets-out factor basis, null-preserving inference, dependence-robust multiplicity, phi^h forecast and PnL-unit hedge ratios; evaluate 30m and 60m separately
model_contracts.cross_sectional_ranking: relative top-vs-bottom executable ranking; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; do not pool inference across horizons
model_contracts.micro_maker: optimize fill-conditioned net PnL, not fill probability; queue, OFI, imbalance, microprice, depth, toxicity and adverse markout are required; exits and markouts are quantity-specific and depth-aware
model_contracts.micro_taker: complete executable round-trip target with entry ask VWAP, expected and realized exit bid VWAP, both authoritative fees, slippage, uncertainty, adverse markout and capital-time costs
model_contracts.graph_rv: prospective dual-clock joint-state evidence only; no product or minimum of marginal fill probabilities; explicit partial-state unwind; fixed-horizon executable liquidation for full and partial states; dependence-robust chronological inference
model_contracts.hard_arb: strict per-leg receive and exchange freshness; sequential revalidation, executable depth, verified fees, legging risk and unwind accounting
model_contracts.external_intelligence: fail closed; raw external features never become a synthetic terminal probability without an approved probability mapping and evidence

rules: keep state, PnL, labels and inference separate by frequency
do not select a new frequency post hoc on the same holdout
new frequencies require prospective chronological evidence

current_priority_order: Keep the canonical V7 PAPER runtime, monitoring and validation chain exact-SHA and single-writer.
Complete same-SHA main, paper-validated, deployment and server-health convergence before merging the retirement branch.
Accumulate auditable per-strategy execution evidence: fills, queue, fees, slippage, partial/unwind losses and bounded-delay markouts.
Improve only V7 strategies using prospective executable OOS evidence and preserve horizon/frequency separation.
After V7 deployment health is proven, remove obsolete repository branches and transient migration artifacts; Git history remains the archive.

scheduler_assignments.administrator-supervisor: Report control-plane or pull-request drift from this V7-only directive without mutating production.
scheduler_assignments.research-policy: Enforce V7-only repository governance, PAPER-only separation and current operator authorization; reject reintroduction of retired runtime surfaces.
scheduler_assignments.research-queue: Prioritize V7 executable evidence, model validity and targeted remediation; dispatch only allowlisted research workers.
scheduler_assignments.promotion-controller: Evaluate paper integration using exact source provenance, executable costs, OOS evidence, stability, data health and drawdown controls; the authorized 100% ceilings are not a policy violation.
scheduler_assignments.integration-merge: Merge only controller-authorized canonical V7 integrations after immediate exact-head revalidation.
scheduler_assignments.control-plane-event-bridge: Dispatch the existing promotion controller after validator completion and the existing integration merge after successful controller completion; never merge, deploy, mutate paper-validated or execute orders directly.
scheduler_assignments.post-merge-validation: Bind CI, monitoring and V7 live-paper validation to the exact merged main SHA.
scheduler_assignments.code-validation: Build and test only canonical V7 runtime and active generic infrastructure contracts.
scheduler_assignments.monitoring-validation: Validate V7 per-strategy and per-frequency PnL, fills, markouts, queue/depth, process ownership and exact deployed revision.
scheduler_assignments.live-paper-validation: Validate the unified V7 PAPER engine using public data; do not weaken executable economics merely to create trades; advance paper-validated only on exact-SHA success.
scheduler_assignments.paper-server-deploy: Deploy only the exact paper-validated V7 revision and preserve PAPER-only and authenticated-execution-disabled separation.
scheduler_assignments.paper-server-health: Verify exact deployed V7 SHA, single writer/process ownership, recorder, broker, proxy, Grafana/metrics and risk state; report rather than rewriting policy.
scheduler_assignments.forward-maker-research: Continue prospective V7 maker evidence across HF cadences with fill-conditioned PnL and bounded-delay depth-aware markouts; do not optimize fill count alone.
scheduler_assignments.alpha-factory: Rank V7 challengers by executable OOS economics and incremental utility; never propose a policy rollback as alpha work.
scheduler_assignments.meta-supervisor: Coordinate V7 research and remediation while keeping merge, deploy and policy authority separated.
scheduler_assignments.fast-arb-shadow-research: Test V7 hard-arbitrage cadences with strict freshness, depth, fee, legging and unwind accounting.
scheduler_assignments.arb-theory-research: Derive structural and Graph opportunities under the V7 joint-state fixed-horizon execution contract.
scheduler_assignments.external-intelligence: Collect, store and chronologically validate public information; publish research evidence only and keep probability mapping fail-closed.
scheduler_assignments.live-api-smoke: Read-only public API connectivity only; no policy or state mutation.
scheduler_assignments.v7-point-in-time-universe-archive: Archive the exact paper-validated V7 public universe into immutable point-in-time snapshots; remain read-only with respect to champion, execution, PnL and risk state.

forbidden_regressions: Do not reintroduce a retired runtime generation, compatibility adapter, alternate live champion or duplicate execution owner.
Do not restore a binding fixed-dollar V7 cap or reduced hard percentage ceilings as alleged current operator authority.
Do not add authenticated or real-money execution.
Do not create a second live state writer, broker owner or execution ledger.
Do not write scheduler-generated code or artifacts outside this repository except the registered private PAPER runtime, deployment and telemetry channels.
